---
name: stack-bootstrap
description: Bootstrap the smallest VenturaGame Python structure for an approved playable 2D MVP using the declared stack. Use when the repository is ready to move from incubation docs to executable code. Do not use when a functional game core already exists or the task is only product scoping.
---

# Stack bootstrap

- Confirm the approved game loop before adding dependencies.
- Add only packages required for the first Pygame or API path.
- Separate generation logic runtime tests and example prompts.
- Use simple licensed or generated placeholder assets.
- Add a deterministic core test that does not require an interactive display when possible.
- Document one local run command and supported environment.
- Reuse the shared repository CI standard.
